issues.problem: The l.2359 hypothesis 'M globally hyperbolic' is replaced by 'M̃ (with T_BTZ) globally hyperbolic'. The transfer M GH ⇒ M̃ GH (lift of a Cauchy surface; lifting inextensible causal curves through the BTZ lines; ETT (iii)⇒(i)) is missing, and the dispatch named it as the content of the package. What remains duplicates lem:globally_hyperbolic_manifolds_manifolds's BTZ~ half. The stated obstruction is real: there is no causality on a SingularGXStructure E₀-manifold M and no bridge to the charted form. But this file already built the analogous causality on M̃ from charts (btzTildeAtlasCausality), so a causality on M generated by its X_A charts into BTZE0 (with GXScaffold.BTZ.Causality's E0 causality) is the same kind of construction. The obstruction is infrastructure, not mathematics.
issues.fix: Either (a) build the causality of M in the SingularGXStructure form (generated by the E₀ charts, as btzTildeAtlasCausality), state 'M GH ⇒ M̃ GH' and prove it, or leave a tagged SORRY(lem:globally_hyperbolic_manifolds_maximal) naming the missing lift-of-Cauchy step; or (b) get an author ruling that accepts the M̃-GH form (DEC-77 (b) says 'causality and GH read in [M̃]', which can be read either way; see questions). Until then the row stays partial.

issues.problem: The paper's def:manifold_future_complete_all is a property of the BTZ-manifold M. The Lean notion is a property of the data d = (T', D, y₀, Φ), and nothing proves it is independent of d. Independence of D up to an isometry is a few lines (an isometry preserves J⁺ and I⁺, and the developed atlas is unchanged); independence of T' rests on WP-41d's chartwise reading.
